mapper.insert: INSERT INTO face_verify_audit ( user_id, session_id, matched, similarity, match_threshold, reject_threshold, model_version, challenge_action, source, baseline_count, best_baseline_id, probe_face_detected, probe_image_urls, best_baseline_image_url, top_sims_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{matched}, #{similarity}, #{matchThreshold}, #{rejectThreshold}, #{modelVersion}, #{challengeAction}, #{source}, #{baselineCount}, #{bestBaselineId}, #{probeFaceDetected}, #{probeImageUrls}, #{bestBaselineImageUrl}, #{topSimsJson}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.session_id, a.matched, a.similarity, a.match_threshold, a.reject_threshold, a.model_version, a.challenge_action, a.source, a.baseline_count, a.best_baseline_id, a.probe_face_detected, a.probe_image_urls, a.best_baseline_image_url, a.top_sims_json, a.created_at, NULL AS user_name FROM face_verify_audit a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE face_verify_audit SET matched = #{matched}, similarity = #{similarity}, match_threshold = #{matchThreshold}, reject_threshold = #{rejectThreshold}, model_version = #{modelVersion}, challenge_action = #{challengeAction}, source = #{source}, baseline_count = #{baselineCount}, best_baseline_id = #{bestBaselineId}, probe_face_detected = #{probeFaceDetected}, probe_image_urls = #{probeImageUrls}, best_baseline_image_url = #{bestBaselineImageUrl}, top_sims_json = #{topSimsJson} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(id) AS keep_id FROM face_verify_audit GROUP BY user_id, IF(CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(IFNULL(session_id, ''))) > 0, session_id, CONCAT('__row__', id)) ) latest ON a.id = latest.keep_id

if.test: triggerType != null and triggerType != '' and triggerType != 'USER'

where.if: AND ( a.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.session_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.model_version LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.source LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM face_verify_audit a
LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON a.user_id = p.user_id
